properties.description:
Reported reproduction: use a depth-one graph, Fit, then scroll one increment. The viewport flickers as scrollbars appear. The graph uses the shared Relational UI ScrollArea. Reproduce through authored simulated input and a persistent exact recording before changing behavior; identify the owning feedback loop and preserve shared scrolling consumers.

Completed: authored an 80-node depth-one star at fractional display scale, then Fit and one wheel increment. The unchanged implementation alternated viewport dimensions across the 40-frame recordings (stable=false); reviewed expectation was stable=true for each step. The same input now exactly matches both expected records. Cause: CircleGraph used rounded clientWidth/clientHeight for its spacer, creating a scrollbar/resize loop. CSS fractional scrollport sizing fixes that integration; ScrollArea continues to own native scrolling. Repeated in the live app after restart. Before/expected/after recordings and raw geometry: graph://planning-26535745-4644-4770-af7c-1980c773377b/entries/2dddb630-5e2e-4d4c-83ed-38a84d43b0db.json. Focused browser regression: graph-controls-ui.spec.ts. Full build and affected-system verification passed.
properties.title: Bug: graph flickers when scrollbars appear after Fit
